goals.title: Standard Speed benchmark family
goals.description:
Standard Speed benchmark family -- DELIVERED. Measures practical local-model execution performance at fixed context points (8K/16K/32K): TTFT, full-prefill + generation throughput, actual input/output tokens, target-vs-actual context error, wall time; calibrated token sizing, cache-busted prefill, warm samples, metric versioning v3. Supporting: model discovery, load/unload lifecycle, shared heavyweight-run guard, dedicated Standard Speed result page, history grouped by run, 8K->16K->32K summaries.

legacy_id (implementation provenance): Act 17, Act 17.1, Act 18, Act 19, Act 19.1, Act 20, Act 22, Act 23. Reference: docs/act-18-model-lifecycle.md.

goals.title: Workflow benchmark family
goals.description:
Workflow benchmark family -- DELIVERED. Deterministic developer-workflow correctness/reliability benchmark: 166 checks, 5 suites, no LLM judge, no subjective scoring, authoritative V2 runner, separate suite execution, durable result artifacts, dedicated Workflow result page. NOT a universal intelligence leaderboard.

legacy_id (implementation provenance): unlabeled v2 quality engine commits (canonical provenance, corpus, runner+execution contract, live executor/extractors/prompts, authoritative artifacts) + Act 8, Act 9, Act 10, Act 11, Act 12 (v2 results UI) + Act 16 (workflow suite launch).

goals.title: Context benchmark family
goals.description:
Context benchmark family -- PLANNED. Measures how model quality/performance change as usable context grows (planned points 15K/30K/60K/120K/180K/240K where supported): quality retention, workflow degradation, TTFT/prefill/degradation growth, context-capacity limits, unsupported-point handling. Unsupported points shown as gaps; scores not rescaled. Future multi-model side-by-side degradation curves.

Status per docs/ROADMAP.md: PLANNED.

goals.title: AI Intelligence benchmark family
goals.description:
AI Intelligence benchmark family -- PLANNED / RESEARCH. Not implemented. Genuinely discriminative model-capability benchmark for cases where Workflow saturates: reasoning, synthesis, planning, judgement, problem solving, instruction interpretation, ambiguity handling, multi-step decision quality. Design goals: avoid easy/saturated tasks, separate capability levels, avoid duplicating Workflow, no single universal number, define scoring before implementation. Current state: no runner/API/persistence/UI/tests.

Status per docs/ROADMAP.md: PLANNED / RESEARCH.

goals.title: Retire legacy Results product
goals.description: Retire the legacy Results product (Maintenance M2) -- Status: PLANNED.
